name: grantcompass-us
description: Find US small business grants, loans and tax credits, and check basic eligibility.

interface.longDescription:
GrantCompass US searches more than 700 US funding programs: federal, state, local and private grants, plus loans and tax credits for small businesses. Describe your business and what you need money for, and it returns the programs that fit, with the amount, whether each one is open right now, and a link to its full page.

Ask whether you qualify for a specific program and it checks the basic requirements (state, type of organization, ownership, number of employees, industry), tells you which you meet, and asks for anything it needs to know. It only checks basic requirements. Each program has more rules on its page, so a "likely fit" is never a guarantee.

No account needed. Covers US programs only. Not for scholarships, student aid or personal loans.
capabilities: Check basic eligibility for a program
defaultPrompt: Find grants for my women-owned bakery in Ohio
Am I eligible for the Amber Grant? I'm a sole proprietor in Texas
What SBIR funding fits a 6-person AI software startup?

positive.description: Search grants for a described business
positive.prompt: Find small business grants for my women-owned bakery in Ohio.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows 3–8 program cards with amount, current open/closed status and a base-level fit; every program is open to Ohio businesses; each card links to its grantcompass.co program page.

positive.description: Check eligibility for a named program
positive.prompt: Am I eligible for the Amber Grant? I'm a woman, sole proprietor in Texas.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows each base requirement as met / not met / need to know, an overall likely-fit verdict, the application status, and what else to check on the program page.

positive.prompt: Using GrantCompass US, what SBIR or STTR programs fit a 6-person AI software startup in California?
positive.expected_behavior: Results include SBIR/STTR programs with their current deadlines or rolling status; no closed program is presented as open.

positive.prompt: How can I pay for new energy-efficient kitchen equipment for my restaurant in California?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_grants for a California restaurant and returns programs that help pay for the new equipment, such as a utility energy-efficiency program, the Section 179 equipment deduction or an SBA equipment loan, each with its amount, current status and a link to its program page.

positive.prompt: Tell me about the SBA 7(a) loan program.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the funder, amounts, current status, who it is for, and a link to the program page.

negative.prompt: Find me scholarships for my daughter's college tuition.

negative.description: Programs outside the US are out of scope
negative.prompt: What small business grants are available in Ontario, Canada?

negative.description: Personal finance is out of scope
negative.prompt: How do I get a personal loan to consolidate my credit card debt?

publication.release_notes: First release. Three read-only tools: search US funding programs, check base-level eligibility for a program, and get one program's details. No login. Results link to informational program pages on grantcompass.co.
